title: Four Puffs Later
scenarioIntro: 74-year-old man with COPD, worsening shortness of breath over two days, used his salbutamol puffer four times before calling. Tests respiratory assessment, bronchodilator treatment and reassessment.
patientPresentation: Tripoding, speaking 2-3 words, accessory muscle use, wheezes throughout.
incidentNarrative: Two days of increasing shortness of breath and cough with green sputum. Used his Ventolin puffer about 4 times in the last hour with little relief. No chest pain. Low-grade fever yesterday.

physicalExam.chest: Wheezes throughout, decreased air entry to bases, accessory muscle use.

withProperTreatment: Salbutamol 5 mg NB: After 10 minutes RR 24, SpO2 92%, speaking full sentences, expiratory wheezes only.
withIncorrectTreatment: No reassessment: Instructor asks for a repeat set of vitals and breath sounds.

expectedTreatment: Repeat vitals and breath sounds after salbutamol

acrKeyFindings.finding: used his puffer about 4 times before calling
decreased air entry to the bases
